title: La carne
goal: Buy meat by weight and get the cut you meant
culture: There is no case to point at and no label to read. You say a weight and what you are cooking, and she cuts for it — that is the service, it is free, and it works better than choosing would.

beats.good: Media libra. It is asked for out loud, by weight, and there is nothing behind the glass to point at.

beats.es: ¿Y para qué la quiere? ¿Para sopa o para asar?
beats.good: Tell her the dish and she picks the cut. You have to know what you are cooking; you do not have to know any butchery.
The bone is where the flavour is and she may well say so, but sin hueso is an ordinary thing to ask for and she will not argue twice.

beats.es: ¿Así está bien, o le pongo un poquito más?
beats.good: Así está bien stops the scale where it is. It is the polite enough, and it works for rice, for beans and for how much they are pouring you.
